counterfactual_text: The still clear water becomes uniformly blue as soon as the compact dye drop enters it.
positive_text: The blue dye begins as a compact spot, and its colored boundary expands progressively through the still clear water.
semantic_text: A drop of blue dye enters still clear water and gradually spreads outward, coloring an expanding region of the water. Required visible entities: one compact blue dye drop; still clear water; transparent water vessel. At the beginning: blue dye: one compact drop separated just above the water surface; water: still, clear, and uniformly uncolored; vessel: transparent and fully visible around the water region. Required state changes: dye position: compact drop to water interior; colored-region area: compact to expanding; color concentration: localized to spatially distributed. These event variables are allowed to change: dye-drop position; colored-region area and boundary; spatial color concentration. Preserve throughout: static close side-view camera; vessel identity and position; background and lighting; one blue dye drop; one region of still clear water; the same water container and camera view.
